crossRefs.note: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
“To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?

translations.web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
translations.bsb: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
translations.kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
translations.asv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is a great god like unto God?
